_why: Shadow mode: these gates still evaluate and still log what they WOULD have blocked, but they do not block. Adopted 2026-08-23; ported to main 2026-08-26 because enforcement had shipped here while the relief stayed on one branch — the worst possible split.
_expiry_is_the_point: Past 'until' these gates block again automatically. This repo's defining failure is that nothing is ever retired; an undated shadow window would become another permanent un-retired thing.
_review_at_expiry: node scripts/gate-telemetry-report.mjs — any hook with zero would_block:true entries retires on evidence.
_allowlist_note: Naming a hook here is NOT sufficient. scripts/lib/gate-shadow.mjs carries a hard SHADOWABLE allowlist; compliance gates (PII egress, spend, secrets, blast-radius) are refused even if listed here.
_deleted_note: dry-loop-gate was DELETED 2026-08-26. It fired on 74 of 157 turns (47%). GLM 5.3: 'no data rescues a smoke alarm that fires at dinner.' Deleted rather than shadowed.

removal_conditions._rule: ox-alpha 2026-08-26: every gate, hook or rule lands WITH its written removal condition in the same session it is created. Mechanisms created without exit criteria are the ratchet that produced a 216KB rulebook.
removal_conditions._kill_threshold: A shadowed gate whose CLEANED fire rate exceeds 15% of runs at window close is DELETED, not tuned. Pre-registered 2026-08-26, before the data, deliberately.
removal_conditions.dual-tier-gate: Retire when >15% cleaned fire rate at window close, OR when closeout summaries are produced without it for 30 consecutive substantial turns.
removal_conditions.hermes-closeout-gate: Retire when >15% cleaned fire rate at window close, OR when the learning corpus shows 30 days of unprompted packets with the gate shadowed.
removal_conditions.egress-privacy-gate: NEVER auto-retires. Compliance gate. Removal requires Sean explicitly, in writing, with a named replacement control.
removal_conditions.spend-guard-gate: NEVER auto-retires. Compliance gate. Same condition as above.
removal_conditions.exit-status-gate: Retire when the corpus shows zero new pipeline-status defects for 90 days. Currently 44 corpus hits and 4 live catches in one task — high precision, keep.
removal_conditions.lane-staged-guard: Retire when agents no longer share one git index (per-agent worktrees). The guard exists only because of the shared index; fix the cause and the guard is dead weight.
